correctness.rationale: For each m>=4 the C3 action is free on geometric points; Thapper gives cover a sphere S^d (d odd) or a two-fold wedge of S^d (d even). The cohomological Serre spectral sequence has rows 0 and d only. In the odd case the top module is trivial. In the even case Lefschetz fixed-point-freeness gives trace -1 on rank two, hence norm zero and determinant(g-1)=3, so top group cohomology is Z/3 in odd columns only. Finite dimensionality forces the transgressions to be nonzero and u-periodicity forces them to be isomorphisms in all positive relevant columns. Surviving cohomology has one filtration piece per degree; UCT gives exact integral torsion and the free top groups. All integer quotient chain squares and mod 2,3,5 homologies for m=4..9 passed an extracted standalone checker; the finite cases are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The natural three-color rotation on triangular cylindrical graphs produces a uniform, complete integral homology classification for every path length m>=4, with one genuine Z/3 class in every odd dimension below an increasing cutoff even though the covers are torsion-free sphere wedges. The sharp residue class m mod 3 governs whether free top homology persists. These higher integral invariants and exact torsion orders cannot be read from the previously determined covering Betti numbers or cyclic fundamental group alone, and resolve a mathematically motivated family rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
